serviceProfile.shortDescription: Accurate dispensing of NHS and private prescriptions with clinical checks, labelling and patient counselling.
serviceProfile.longDescription: Prescription Dispensing is a core prescription and medicines supply offering delivered by UK community pharmacies under GPhC regulation.
